vapid.party - Cloudflare Web Push and XMTP alert relay

Base URL:
- https://vapid.party

Runtime:
- Cloudflare Worker, D1, Cloudflare Queue, and one singleton Cloudflare
  Container running a custom Go XMTP v3 SubscribeAll listener.
- No Vercel/Next or PostgreSQL runtime is supported.
- Public health reported deliveryReady=true, listener ready, and bridge synced
  on 2026-07-14.
- A post-deployment real-Chrome canary passed XMTP welcome and group delivery,
  three HMAC epochs, own-message and shouldPush=false suppression, and cleanup.
- Push remains experimental because SubscribeAll has no durable replay cursor;
  restart/disconnect hints can be missed while XMTP client sync remains authoritative.

OpenAPI:
- /openapi.yaml

Response shape:
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": ... }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "error": "...", "code": "...", "details": ...? }`
- Validation errors use HTTP 422 and include `details.issues[]`.

Public health:
- GET /api/health
- Top-level status only describes the Worker.
- `data.xmtp.deliveryReady` requires a fresh listener heartbeat, connected XMTP
  stream, successful internal delivery probe, and a D1-synchronized bridge with
  zero pending or failed registrations.
- The response never exposes internal URLs, tokens, endpoints, or HMAC keys.

Public Converge XMTP routes:
- GET /api/xmtp/vapid-public-key
- POST /api/xmtp/subscriptions
- DELETE /api/xmtp/subscriptions
- POST /api/xmtp/status
- POST /api/xmtp/status/test

Converge registration:
- No client secret or X-API-Key.
- Version is 1 and app.id must be `converge.cv`.
- Identity contains a 64-hex inboxId and 64-hex installationId. An optional
  address is accepted for wire compatibility but is not needed for routing.
- Subscription is a standard browser PushSubscription.
- Group topics are `/xmtp/mls/1/g-<32 lowercase hex>/proto` and require HMAC keys.
- Welcome topic is `/xmtp/mls/1/w-<64 lowercase hex>/proto` and has no HMAC key.
- Include every backing DM/group topic and every current HMAC epoch from XMTP.
- notification.inboxHandle is an opaque base64url local-routing token, never a
  display name or raw inbox id.
- preferences.minimalPayloadOnly must be true.
- preferences.plaintextPreview must be false.
- Only the strict nested version-1 body is public; flattened legacy bodies fail.
- Browser endpoints are restricted to canonical HTTPS FCM, Mozilla autopush,
  Apple Web Push, and WNS shapes.
- Maximums: 400 topics, 800 combined topic/HMAC rows, 1024 characters per
  base64 key, uint32 epochs. The max row contract assumes paid D1 limits.
- One active logical route exists per app/inbox/installation. Active endpoint
  p256dh/auth keys are immutable, though several logical routes can share them.
- Send X-Vapid-Party-Diagnostics: 1 to receive a random 256-bit management
  receipt in the no-store response. The server stores only its hash.
- Send the receipt only as Authorization: Bearer. Endpoint replacement and
  post-bootstrap deletion require it; replacement preserves it for safe retry.
- Exact endpoint/key refresh can bootstrap or recover a receipt for deployed
  client compatibility.
- POST /api/xmtp/status has an empty body and returns secret-free route coverage,
  listener/bridge readiness, and delivery stages.
- POST /api/xmtp/status/test queues only `{type:"vapid.diagnostic",testId}`.
  `sent` means provider accepted, not that the browser displayed it.
- First public claim is not signed XMTP ownership proof and can be squatted for
  denial of service. This route is Converge-only, not general app enrollment.

Authenticated app routes:
- Pre-provisioned apps use X-API-Key.
- GET /api/vapid/public-key
- POST /api/subscribe
- POST /api/send
- POST /api/xmtp/registrations
- DELETE /api/xmtp/registrations
- The API key selects app scope; the registration request cannot override it.
- App provisioning and key rotation are operator-only. The old wallet-admin
  routes are removed and return 404.

Listener delivery:
- POST /api/internal/xmtp/deliveries
- Requires Authorization: Bearer INTERNAL_INGEST_TOKEN.
- Production Container sends a minimal version-1 event with idempotencyKey,
  installationId, opaque app deliveryToken, topic, messageType, shouldPush, and
  isSilent.
- The previous official HTTP SendRequest and legacy internal path/header remain
  transitional compatibility inputs.
- The relay never needs an HMAC secret in the delivery request.

XMTP Web Push payload:
- type: `xmtp.new_message`
- inboxHandle: opaque local routing token
- No title, body, URL, conversation id, sender, preview, ciphertext, or message content.
- The receiving app owns notification copy, navigation, XMTP sync, and decryption.

Privacy:
- vapid.party stores routing metadata and Web Push material needed for delivery.
- It never stores, forwards, or previews plaintext XMTP text, sender names,
  decrypted content, attachment URLs, previews, or encrypted envelopes.
